hook: The AI gave you a 5-paragraph essay. You wanted a one-liner. Again.
caption:
The AI gave you a 5-paragraph essay. You wanted a one-liner. Again.

Here's what's actually happening:

ChatGPT doesn't know if you're a "give me the full picture" person or a "just tell me the answer" person. So it guesses. And it guesses wrong. A lot.

Some people need context before the conclusion or it doesn't stick.

Some people need the conclusion first or they stop reading.

Neither is better. They're just different brains.

The fix isn't typing "be concise" every single time like a broken record. That's a workaround, not a solution.

The fix is AI that already knows you default to bottom-line-first thinking. So it leads with the answer, keeps the explanation optional, and never makes you wade through a preamble to get to the thing you actually asked.

That's what a BootFile does. It's a profile of how YOUR brain processes information — built once, applied every time.

Stop training AI from scratch on every conversation.
